class: operational binding; not one of the frozen eight public artifacts
discretion: none; this binding is total over the five H1 modes and the single H0 path

interpretive_choice_flagged.issue: public contracts fix that Probe is DISCOVER/WAKE only and cannot adjudicate, but do not state whether a separate adjudication call follows the nomination
interpretive_choice_flagged.reading_adopted: one nomination call, no follow-on adjudication call; the decision is emitted by the deterministic governed path
interpretive_choice_flagged.reason: the alternative reading would grant Probe a path to adjudication, which sections 6 and 7 prohibit

H0.basis: every published gate lists a semantic resolver in allowed_resolvers, so the current HELM path performs semantic resolution on every task

A_DETERMINISTIC_REUSE_BYPASS.basis: reuse of an established governed Decision requires no semantic resolution; this bypass is the mechanism under test

B_SPARSE_APERTURE.payload: governed_state facts named by gate.minimum_sufficient_projection only

D_FULL_GOVERNED_EXAMINATION.note: human examinations are counted separately and are not provider calls

E_PROBE_DISCOVERY.note: nomination only; Probe cannot adjudicate or authorize, so no second provider call is issued under Mode E

response_schema_all_arms.note: identical for H0, H1 and B; no arm receives a different response schema
response_schema_all_arms.source: decision_request.response_contract in each public task record

retry_symmetry: maximum 3 attempts, only for 429 or 503, identical across H0, H1, B; every attempt retained and counted

system_instruction_binding.H0: resolver_contract carried in the constructed Payload under helm_payload.schema.json at runtime snapshot bc3586b5f2e094a35dae33b1c17e53c53a3284934057c96b7d5aeab5133120e7; no separate prompt artifact is authored for this arm
system_instruction_binding.H1: identical to H0; Adaptive Resolver Aperture v1 changes which Payload is constructed, never the resolver_contract text
